result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with parallel parking on both sides and buildings situated directly at the sidewalk edge. Pedestrian infrastructure is minimal, consisting of narrow sidewalks with utility pole obstructions and no visible marked crossings or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, poorly maintained residential sidewalk with significant cracking and uneven pavement. There is no buffer between the walkway and on-street parking, and the environment is further degraded by litter and a vacant lot frontage.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant tripping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk is immediately adjacent to parked cars and the travel lane with no physical or vertical separation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the cracked and uneven concrete with a smooth, ADA-compliant surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the environment.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is constrained by narrow sidewalks and significant obstructions from parked vehicles, including a large van blocking the walkway on the right. There is a complete absence of visible crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, at the approaching intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white van is parked partially on the sidewalk on the right side of the image, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking blocks sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at the intersection ahead, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking at the corners.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses built directly to the sidewalk edge. Pedestrian movement is hindered by overgrown vegetation and parked vehicles that encroach on the narrow walkway, and there is a lack of formal crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Vegetation Obstruction
hazards.description: A large bush on the left side significantly narrows the usable sidewalk width, potentially forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: The white van is parked extremely close to the sidewalk edge, creating a pinch point and blocking sightlines for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces on the sidewalk and roadway create tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
